title: Create src/tui/components/DecideScreen.tsx
description: Create the Ink component shown when the AI outputs a <decide> tag. Shows the question, accepts user input, and writes the answer to .agent/decisions.md.
acceptanceCriteria: DecideScreen renders a yellow 'Decision Needed' header
After submission, calls onDecide(answer) callback to resume or exit loop

steps.details: Create the file. Import React, useState, Box, Text from ink. Import TextInput from ink-text-input. Import fs-extra and path for file writing.

Return: <Box flexDirection='column' marginTop={1}><Text bold color='yellow'>🤔 Decision Needed</Text><Text marginTop={1}>{question}</Text><Box marginTop={1}><Text>Your answer: </Text><TextInput value={answer} onChange={setAnswer} onSubmit={handleSubmit} /></Box></Box>

technicalNotes: decisions.md accumulates all decisions made during the project — it's a useful reference for the AI in future iterations
